states.name: ghr
states.meaning: 7-bit global branch history register; shifted left on each predicted branch, with the predicted direction inserted at the LSB

states.name: pht
states.meaning: 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters indexed by (pc[6:0] XOR ghr[6:0])

rules.spec_quote: Reset is asynchronous active-high.
the branch predictor produces the predicted branch direction and state of the branch history register used to make the prediction
When a branch prediction is requested (predict_valid = 1)
The branch history register is then updated (at the next positive clock edge) for the predicted branch.
if the branch being trained is mispredicted, also recover the branch history register to the state immediately after the mispredicting branch completes execution
Update the pattern history table (PHT) to train the branch predictor to predict this branch more accurately next time.
When this happens, training takes precedence, because the branch being predicted will be discarded anyway.

before.mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: Spec does not state output values when predict_valid=0; assumed predict_taken=0 and predict_history=current ghr.
candidates: outputs undefined/hold previous values when predict_valid=0
